freeze.fixture_note: Early correctness fixtures used seeds 211/213 with 30 runs; they were moved to 41/43 before freeze. No 120-run follow-up world was evaluated before freeze. This is not claimed to be preregistered or untouched holdout evaluation.
freeze.review: Independent read-only review found no blocker for the bounded loss-only experiment.
freeze.status: Frozen after correctness tests, before the bounded 120-run experiment

policy_assumptions.authentication_scope: Trusted retained simulator receipts; no cryptographic verification or forged-record model.
policy_assumptions.completeness_scope: Channel-wide; affected channel incomplete at nominal retention below 1, regardless of realized loss.
policy_assumptions.mask_rule: One independent SHA-256 rank per public receipt key and mask seed; same ranks reused at all retention levels.
policy_assumptions.negative_evidence: Absence excludes exposure only when declared complete relevant logging makes that absence informative.
policy_assumptions.positive_evidence: Semantically valid context-entry receipt supports exposure even without upstream logs; it does not establish source selection.
policy_assumptions.unknown_handling: Unresolved exposure candidates never enter scored predictions; burden is reported separately.

study_type: follow-up stress test informed by review; not preregistered
